admission.justification: Prevents replay loading changed live instructions instead of the exact immutable detail bytes of its original request.

applicability: Manifest-declared named-step details used by the original launch, same-request retry or delayed held-seat opening.
conditions: Freeze original detail bytes and revision beside the report and bind rendered references to those immutable per-request paths.
Under compact_links=True, every interior directory of <stem>.details/<source> is verified non-symlink and confined within the report directory.
Restoration validates both nested and legacy flat snapshots before use, refusing changed or nonregular artifacts without regenerating them.
exclusions: No refresh from current live source on replay.
Step details do not hide required inline stage inputs, outputs or authority boundaries.
statement: Launch preparation freezes immutable step-detail snapshots beside the handover — in symlink-confined <stem>.details/<source> nested paths with absolute internal links under compact_links=True, or flat <stem>.detail-<sha256>.md paths under legacy mode — binds rendered references to those original bytes, validates both layouts without regenerating damaged details on restore, and excludes .details/** and Turn-1 offload sidecars from canonical execution reports.
title: Launch freezes symlink-confined step-detail snapshots beside handover
